classes.name: adjustable rate dividend
classes.label: adjustable rate dividend
classes.definition: dividend that varies with a benchmark

classes.name: auction rate dividend
classes.label: auction rate dividend
classes.definition: preferred share dividend whose rate is periodically reset through an auction, typically every 7, 14, 28, or 35 days

classes.name: common share
classes.label: common share
classes.definition: share that signifies a unit of ownership in a corporation and represents a claim on part of the corporation's assets and earnings

classes.name: convertible common share
classes.label: convertible common share
classes.definition: common share that is convertible into another security

classes.name: convertible preferred share
classes.label: convertible preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that includes an option for the holder to convert the shares into a fixed number of common shares after a predetermined date

classes.name: cumulative preferred share
classes.label: cumulative preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share whose dividends, if not paid on time, accumulate until paid out

classes.name: custodian
classes.label: custodian
classes.definition: financial institution that holds customers' securities for safekeeping

classes.name: dividend
classes.label: dividend
classes.definition: announced commitment to make a specific distribution of a portion of earnings to shareholders, prorated by class of security

classes.name: dividend distribution method
classes.label: dividend distribution method
classes.definition: convention by which dividends are provided to shareholders

classes.name: dividend schedule
classes.label: dividend schedule
classes.definition: payment schedule indicating the dates on which dividends are due to be paid

classes.name: enhanced voting share
classes.label: enhanced voting share
classes.definition: share that confers more than one vote per share

classes.name: equity conversion terms
classes.label: equity conversion terms
classes.definition: conversion terms specifying the details regarding conversion of shares into other securities

classes.name: equity position
classes.label: equity position
classes.definition: position in an equity instrument

classes.name: equity redemption provision
classes.label: equity redemption provision
classes.definition: redemption provision that specifies the conditions under which the issuer or shareholder may redeem the shares

classes.name: equity redemption provision with extendable redemption date
classes.label: equity redemption provision with extendable redemption date
classes.definition: equity redemption provision that allows modification of the redemption date beyond the original specified date

classes.name: exchangeable preferred share
classes.label: exchangeable preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that may be exchanged for a security of another issuer

classes.name: extendable preferred share
classes.label: extendable preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share whose redemption date can be extended at the issuer or holder option

classes.name: fixed rate dividend
classes.label: fixed rate dividend
classes.definition: dividend that provides a specified annual return on the nominal value (and any premium) paid on shares

classes.name: fully paid share
classes.label: fully paid share
classes.definition: share whose payment status indicates that no additional money is owed to the company by shareholders on the value of the shares

classes.name: hard retractable preferred share
classes.label: hard retractable preferred share
classes.definition: retractable preferred share whose retraction value must be paid in cash

classes.name: limited partnership unit
classes.label: limited partnership unit
classes.definition: share in a form of partnership similar to a general partnership, except that in addition to one or more general partners (GPs), there are one or more limited partners (LPs)

classes.name: listed share
classes.label: listed share
classes.definition: share that is listed on at least one platform

classes.name: nil paid share
classes.label: nil paid share
classes.definition: share whose payment status indicates that none of the market value has been received by the company for the shares

classes.name: non-cumulative preferred share
classes.label: non-cumulative preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share whose dividend payments are not carried forward

classes.name: non-participating preferred share
classes.label: non-participating preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that is not a participating preferred share

classes.name: non-voting share
classes.label: non-voting share
classes.definition: share that has no voting right

classes.name: ordinary dividend
classes.label: ordinary dividend
classes.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders periodically

classes.name: partially paid share
classes.label: partially paid share
classes.definition: share whose payment status indicates that only a portion of the market value has been received by the company for the shares

classes.name: participating preferred share
classes.label: participating preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that, in addition to paying a stipulated dividend, gives the holder the right to participate with common share holders in additional distributions of earnings under specified conditions

classes.name: perpetual preferred share
classes.label: perpetual preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that has no fixed maturity date

classes.name: precedence right
classes.label: precedence right
classes.definition: right that give the shareholder higher priority with respect to certain pre-defined dividend payments over other shareholders and that pay out first in the case of liquidation

classes.name: preferred dividend
classes.label: preferred dividend
classes.definition: commitment to distribute a portion of earnings to shareholders, similar to a dividend but often with a fixed payment amount and schedule

classes.name: preferred share
classes.label: preferred share
classes.definition: share that pays dividends at a specified rate and has preference over common shares in the payment of dividends and liquidation of corporate assets

classes.name: preferred share with adjustable rate dividend
classes.label: preferred share with adjustable rate dividend
classes.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate varies according to some benchmark

classes.name: preferred share with auction rate dividend
classes.label: preferred share with auction rate dividend
classes.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate is periodically reset through an auction, such as a Dutch auction

classes.name: preferred share with fixed maturity date
classes.label: preferred share with fixed maturity date
classes.definition: preferred share whose maturity date is set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus

classes.name: preferred share with fixed rate dividend
classes.label: preferred share with fixed rate dividend
classes.definition: preferred share whose dividends are set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus

classes.name: price per share
classes.label: price per share
classes.definition: price for one share of a given security at some point in time

classes.name: privately held share
classes.label: privately held share
classes.definition: share in a security that signifies ownership in an entity that is not publicly traded

classes.name: qualified dividend
classes.label: qualified dividend
classes.definition: dividend that falls under capital gains tax rates that are lower than the income tax rates on unqualified (ordinary) dividends

classes.name: redeemable preferred share
classes.label: redeemable preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that gives the issuer the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions

classes.name: redeemable preferred share with extendable maturity date
classes.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable maturity date
classes.definition: redeemable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer has the option to extend the maturity date
parents: preferred share with fixed maturity date

classes.name: redeemable preferred share with extendable redemption date
classes.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable redemption date
classes.definition: redeemable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified

rules.value: equity redemption provision with extendable redemption date

classes.name: restricted share
classes.label: restricted share
classes.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions

classes.name: restricted voting share
classes.label: restricted voting share
classes.definition: share that confers less than one vote per share

classes.name: retractable preferred share
classes.label: retractable preferred share
classes.definition: preferred share that gives the owner (shareholder) the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions

classes.name: retractable preferred share with extendable maturity date
classes.label: retractable preferred share with extendable maturity date
classes.definition: retractable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer and/or holders have the option to extend the maturity date
parents: preferred share with fixed maturity date

classes.name: retractable preferred share with extendable redemption date
classes.label: retractable preferred share with extendable redemption date
classes.definition: retractable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified

rules.value: equity redemption provision with extendable redemption date

classes.name: share
classes.label: share
classes.definition: financial instrument that signifies a unit of equity ownership in a corporation, or a unit of ownership in a mutual fund, or interest in a general or limited partnership, or a unit of ownership in a structured product, such as a real estate investment trust

classes.name: share issuer
classes.label: share issuer
classes.definition: issuer of securities that represent an ownership interest in something

classes.name: share payment status
classes.label: share payment status
classes.definition: classifier that specifies the overall payment status for shares issued

classes.name: share yield
classes.label: share yield
classes.definition: ratio of the annualized dividend per share divided by the (current) price per share

classes.name: single voting share
classes.label: single voting share
classes.definition: share that has the right to exactly one vote

classes.name: soft retractable preferred share
classes.label: soft retractable preferred share
classes.definition: retractable preferred share whose retraction value may be paid in cash or in an equal value of common stock of the issuer, at the option of the issuer

classes.name: special dividend
classes.label: special dividend
classes.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders on a one-time basis

classes.name: unrestricted share
classes.label: unrestricted share
classes.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is not subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions

classes.name: variable interest entity share
classes.label: variable interest entity share
classes.definition: share that certifies ownership of a contractual right to a percentage of a company's profits

classes.name: voting right
classes.label: voting right
classes.definition: contractual right that specifies shareholder voting entitlements, such as to elect directors, elect outside auditors, and vote on matters of corporate policy

edges.name: has adjustable dividend rate
edges.label: has adjustable dividend rate
edges.definition: indicates a variable dividend rate, typically specified in the prospectus as a formula based on a benchmark or set at auction

edges.name: has distribution method
edges.label: has distribution method
edges.definition: indicates the method by which dividend payments are to be distributed

edges.name: has dividend
edges.label: has dividend
edges.definition: relates a share to a dividend that applies to that share, or that the share may pay

edges.name: has declaration date
edges.label: has declaration date
edges.definition: indicates a date on which an organization states that a dividend payment may be anticipated, including the the dividend amount and the ex-dividend and payment dates

edges.name: has dividend grace period
edges.label: has dividend grace period
edges.definition: indicates a period of time after a dividend payment becomes due, before the issuer is subject to penalties

edges.name: has earliest redemption date
edges.label: has earliest redemption date
edges.definition: indicates a date on or after which a stock can be redeemed

edges.name: has ex-dividend date
edges.label: has ex-dividend date
edges.definition: indicates a date on which a stock 'goes ex-dividend', typically about three weeks before the dividend is paid to shareholders of record

edges.name: has fixed dividend rate
edges.label: has fixed dividend rate
edges.definition: indicates a pre-arranged fixed dividend rate, typically specified in the prospectus, for a preferred share

edges.name: has minimum redemption price
edges.label: has minimum redemption price
edges.definition: indicates the lowest market price above which a share may be redeemed

edges.name: has record date
edges.label: has record date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which the issuer checks to determine whether a party was on the company's books as a shareholder when required (i.e., they must have been on the books prior to the ex-dividend date), to identify who is eligible to receive the next dividend

edges.name: has redemption premium
edges.label: has redemption premium
edges.definition: indicates the premium price per share over the market price, if any, that must be paid in order to redeem the stock

edges.name: has share payment status
edges.label: has share payment status
edges.definition: indicates the payment status for shares issued

edges.name: is senior to
edges.label: is senior to
edges.definition: indicates that a given share (share class) has higher seniority than the related share, meaning that it gives the holder a higher claim on the assets of the issuer

edges.name: specifies conversion date
edges.label: specifies conversion date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which, or after which, conversion may occur

attributes.name: number of votes per share
attributes.label: number of votes per share
attributes.definition: grants the right to vote on a per share basis to the shareholder

attributes.name: has available shares
attributes.label: has available shares
attributes.definition: indicates the number of shares outstanding less those shares that are restricted, i.e., those that are available for trading

attributes.name: has extendable maturity date
attributes.label: has extendable maturity date
attributes.definition: indicates whether the issuer and/or holders of redeemable shares with a fixed maturity date have the option to extend the maturity date

attributes.name: has extendable redemption date
attributes.label: has extendable redemption date
attributes.definition: indicates whether the issuer and/or holders of redeemable shares with a specified redemption date have the option to extend that date

attributes.name: has floating stock
attributes.label: has floating stock
attributes.definition: indicates the number of shares that are available for trading, i.e., the number of shares outstanding less closely held shares (those held by insiders) and restricted shares

attributes.name: has share class
attributes.label: has share class
attributes.definition: indicates the class to which the share belongs, typically differentiated by privileges, such as voting rights

attributes.name: has shares issued
attributes.label: has shares issued
attributes.definition: indicates the actual number of shares held by shareholders (i.e., shares outstanding) and treasury shares

attributes.name: has shares outstanding
attributes.label: has shares outstanding
attributes.definition: indicates the number of shares currently held by shareholders, including those held by retail investors, institutional investors and insiders, and typically available for trading

attributes.name: has treasury shares
attributes.label: has treasury shares
attributes.definition: indicates the number of shares issued but not outstanding, including those that were available in the market at one time but have been repurchased by the company

attributes.name: has voting restriction
attributes.label: has voting restriction
attributes.definition: specifies restrictions on voting rights, if any

attributes.name: is redeemable at issuer option
attributes.label: is redeemable at issuer option
attributes.definition: indicates whether the issuer has the option of initiating the buy-back, similar to a call feature

attributes.name: is redeemable at shareholder option
attributes.label: is redeemable at shareholder option
attributes.definition: indicates whether the shareholder has the option of initiating the buy-back, similar to a put feature
